trap.label: decide/choose + to
trap.wrong: I decided learning to code, and I chose study at night.
trap.right: I decided to learn to code, and I chose to study at night.
trap.why: Em português “decidi aprender” e “escolhi estudar” seguem o infinitivo; o brasileiro usa -ing ou omite o to. Em inglês, decide, want e choose pedem to + base.

fix.right: We decided not to buy it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “I decide to learn Python.”
Reescreva com want: “I wanted a site. I build it.”
rewrite.answer: I wanted to build a site.
